pages.title: Getting Another Copy
pages.text: Run $(o)/mc3dprint guide$(). It hands out a fresh working Handbook, and $(l)any player$() can run it.$(br2)The book arrives automatically the first time you craft a printer or pick up a disc, but only $(l)once per player$().
Or just craft another: an $(item)Extrudium Crystal$() and a $(item)Book$(), shapeless.

pages.title: Why /give Fails
pages.text: This is a $(l)Patchouli$() book, so its item id is $(o)patchouli:guide_book$(). There is no $(o)mc3dprint:$() id to give.$(br2)A plain $(o)/give$() produces an $(l)unbound$() copy that will not open, because it never records $(o)which$() book the stack is.$(br2)$(o)/mc3dprint guide$() does.
